newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bancomer loans $1.4 bln to exporters in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Bancomer loans $1.4 bln to exporters in Q1.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Bancomer said on Thursday it loaned $1.4 billion to Mexican exporters in the first quarter.

"In the first quarter, around 1,800 clients received financing from the banks' own resources for around $1.4 billion," Oscar Adam, foreign trade director of the bank, Mexico's second largest, told reporters.

Mexican banks have had trouble lending to clients serving the Mexican domestic market because of the lingering slump in domestic consumption in the aftermath of the 1994-5 peso crisis. But exporters have been ready borrowers since the peso was devalued.
